title: Depth of a module killed by an ideal is the same over the quotient ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] (a Noetherian commutative ring with exactly one maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$), $I\subseteq\mathfrak m$ an ideal, and $M$ a finite $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] with $IM=0$, so that $M$ is a finite module over the Noetherian local ring $\bar R=R/I$, with maximal ideal $\bar{\mathfrak m}=\mathfrak m/I$, by $(r\bmod I)\cdot m=rm$. Then the depth of $M$ as an $R$-module equals the depth of $M$ as an $\bar R$-module: $\operatorname{depth}_{\mathfrak m}(M)=\operatorname{depth}_{\bar{\mathfrak m}}(M)$ [def-weil-pbc-depth]. In particular (for $M=R/I$) the depth of the local ring $R/I$ equals the depth of $R/I$ as an $R$-module.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0AUK (lemma-depth-goes-down-finite, line 18048) applied to the finite ring map $R\to R/I$, whose only maximal ideal is $\mathfrak m/I$ and for which $N_{\mathfrak m/I}=N$ as $R/I$ is local. Tag verified in tags/tags: 0AUK,algebra-lemma-depth-goes-down-finite

proof.text: Give R/I its nontrivial local ring structure using Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff and IsLocalRing.of_surjective' as in [lem-weil-pbc-quotient-local-structure]. Give M the canonical quotient module structure from hIM.module and obtain Module.Finite over R/I by Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite, using [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. No Noetherian permanence theorem is needed: depth is defined for finite modules over any commutative ring.

proof.text: For any surjective algebra map between local rings with compatible actions on M, use AddEquiv.isRegular_congr for the identity additive equivalence and algebraMap_smul to transfer regular sequences [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Surjectivity lifts every list by Function.Surjective.list_map. IsLocalHom.of_surjective and maximalIdeal_comap show that each lifted element belongs to the source maximal ideal exactly when its image belongs to the target maximal ideal; map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective gives the forward inclusion [lem-weil-pbc-quotient-local-structure]. List.length_map shows equality of the sets of regular-sequence lengths.

source.place: Algebra, Definition Tag 00LF (definition-regular-sequence), applied to the quotient map in Lemma Tag 0AUK (lemma-depth-goes-down-finite)

proof.text: In the same surjective scalar-change situation, map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective followed by Ideal.smul_restrictScalars shows that the target maximal ideal times M restricts to the source maximal ideal times M. Injectivity of restriction of scalars identifies the two conditions that this submodule is top. Unfold [def-weil-pbc-depth]: in the top case both depths are infinity, including the zero module; otherwise equality of the sets of lengths gives equality of their suprema. The proved private helper depth_eq_of_surjective packages these steps. Apply it twice to the quotient map, once to M with hIM.module, once to R/I with its canonical actions. Combine the two equalities by And.intro.

lean.statement: theorem depth_over_quotient_ring (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (I : Ideal R) (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal R) (M : Type v) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] (hIM : Module.IsTorsionBySet R M (I : Set R)) : letI : Nontrivial (R ⧸ I) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).ne_top hI) letI : IsLocalRing (R ⧸ I) := IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective letI : Module (R ⧸ I) M := hIM.module haveI : Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) M := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite R (R ⧸ I) M depth (R := R ⧸ I) M = depth (R := R) M ∧ depth (R := R ⧸ I) (R ⧸ I) = depth (R := R) (R ⧸ I)
